title: Model Capability Taxonomer & Signal Normalizer Playbook
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Purpose: create a reusable, machine-readable taxonomy of model capabilities and an automated signal normalizer that ingests heterogeneous competitive signals (benchmarks, release notes, latency/economics telemetry, vendor statements) and emits normalized attributes usable by product, model ops, and procurement.

Scope: 1) Define a capability taxonomy focused on enterprise adoption dimensions (latency buckets, quantization support, privacy posture, multi-turn state, tool-calling, embedding stability, tokenization differences, cost-per-1k-output tokens). 2) Implement a prototype signal normalizer that maps raw inputs into the taxonomy with confidence scoring and provenance. 3) Expose normalized signals via a small REST index and a PRD for downstream dashboards and automated alerts. 4) Create an onboarding guide and test harness for continuous scouting pipelines.

Success metrics: taxonomy v1 covering >= 90% of signals we currently track, normalizer accuracy >= 85% on held-out expert-labeled dataset, end-to-end ingest latency < 15 minutes for new vendor signals, and at least two product/ops teams using normalized attributes in decisioning flows within two sprints after delivery.
acceptance_criteria: Taxonomy document published in Confluence with versioning and examples
Normalizer prototype code and unit tests in GitHub with CI passing
Mapping coverage report showing >= 90% signal-to-attribute coverage on sampled historical signals
REST index endpoint returning normalized attributes and provenance for a given vendor/model id
Integration README and quickstart for product/ops teams
Evaluation notebook with labeled dataset and accuracy/confidence metrics >= 85%

2026-03-12 - Product Review: PM triage accepted the taxonomy shape. Decided to prioritize enterprise-focused attributes for the initial release and defer niche benchmark mapping to v1.1.

notes: Trade-offs discussed: heavier semantic extraction yields better coverage but increases pipeline complexity and maintenance cost. We agreed to ship hybrid approach: deterministic parsers + a lightweight classifier for edge cases. Long-term plan to migrate classifier to the signal-hub inference cluster with rate-limited scoring. Budget for labeling approx. 400 expert-labeled signals allocated to Solutions Eng. Consider cross-referencing with PM-374211 (field signal onboarding) for harmonization.
